description_en: Queries whether a specified virtual border router (VBR) is associated with a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance
description_zh: 查询指定边界路由器（VBR）实例是否在指定地域下绑定有智能接入网关实例
kebab_example: aliyun smartag describe-sag-vbr-relations --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vbr-region-id cn-hangzhou --vbr-instance-ids vbr-bp15ihkk93ezxppk0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSagVbrRelations

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the region where the SAG instance is deployed.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~69813~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
parameters.description_zh:

您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~69813~~)接口查询智能接入网关支持的地域以及对应的地域ID。
